meaning:
νοσσιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(νοσσός),
late form of cl., νεοσσιά,
[in LXX chiefly for קֵן ;]
1. a nest of birds.
2. a brood of young birds: Luk.13:34.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers…
